notes:
Summary:
- Mid-market SaaS (product analytics + in-app insights) evaluating Redwood Hosted -> Dedicated. Goal: replace ad-hoc self-host + OpenAI combo to lower latency and predictable cost.

Hosted trial takeaways (metrics observed):
- Trial period: 2025-11-06 -> 2025-12-06 (30 days).
- Total tokens consumed (trial): ~18.4M tokens (prompt+response).
- Observed QPS: avg 5.2 QPS, peak 21.7 QPS (spike during feature launch test).
- Concurrency: average ~22 concurrent streams; peak concurrency observed ~68.
- Token mix: ~70% short interactions (<256 tokens), ~25% medium (256-1024), ~5% long (>1024).
- Avg tokens per request: ~380. Streaming enabled for 85% of chat flows.
- P95 latency (hosted): 220ms for short replies; customer wants P95 <= 200ms for product-critical flows.
- Cost note: Hosted trial consumed free credits quickly; finance flagged serverless per-token unpredictability. Customer prefers committed capacity pricing for predictability.

Use-case / Requirements:
- Primary: in-app assistant for product analytics queries (structured logs + docs).
- Secondary: support-triage (short responses), doc-search / embeddings for internal KB (embedding QPS low but frequent).
- Throughput target for Dedicated: baseline 12 QPS sustained, expected steady-state 40 QPS during peak days, planning headroom for 3x growth -> target capacity request: sustain 100 QPS, burst to 250 QPS, concurrency planning ~80 streams.
- Latency SLO: P95 <= 200ms for short prompts (<256 tokens); P95 <= 700ms for medium requests.
- Model mix: default to smaller verified 7B-13B models for high-frequency cheap routing; automatic fallback to 70B (or higher qual) for research/long form answers. Wants ability to pin model families per route.
- Caching: high interest in prefix/KV caching for repeated analytics prompts; customer reported 35% repeated prefixes in the trial.
- Routing: need regional routing (NA primary, EU data residency for EU customers).

POC / Dedicated sizing asks (from infra & product teams):
- Provide recommended GPU pool size equivalent to supporting 100 sustained QPS with token mix above. Request includes: concurrency targets, expected token throughput per second, and recommended reserve for 2x burst.
- Ask for example cost model: committed monthly vs pay-as-you-go, with breakpoints at 50QPS, 100QPS, 200QPS. Include example monthly token volumes and estimated unit cost after commit.

Security & Compliance:
- SSO/SAML required (already part of SAML config checklist).
- Audit logs and retention: legal wants 1 year of audit trail for inference requests and admin actions.
- KMS integration for key wrapping and customer-owned keys.
- Pen test report and SOC2/ISO evidence requested before procurement.

- "Trial showed value but finance wants predictable committed pricing; open to Dedicated if math works." — CFO (email 2026-03-02)
